definitions.bridged_entries: Emitted records containing a donor group shared by more than one distinct serialized metal site.
definitions.entry_all_metal_sites_structural: Every in-domain metal site in the entry is structural rather than audit-only.
definitions.entry_any_structural: At least one metal site has a native donor incidence or a native in-domain or external metal-center relation.
definitions.haptic_entries: Emitted records containing a reconstructed pi_fragment with hapticity greater than one.
definitions.haptic_main_class_partition: Confirmed haptic entries, identified by the haptic scope flag, are partitioned among strict nonpolymeric single-center, nonpolymeric multiple/external-relation, and polymeric records. Ambiguous pi candidates are excluded.
definitions.metal_block_statistics: Block-presence entry counts are nonexclusive. The s-only, p-only, d-only, f-only, and mixed signature counts are mutually exclusive.
definitions.native_source_scope: Donor, bridge, haptic, and metal-relation fields transcribe the CSD-native molecular bond graph supplied by the API. No distance-derived contact is added to the structural record.
definitions.nonzero_translation_edge_entries: Emitted records containing at least one resolved nonzero image delta on a metal-donor, in-domain metal-metal, or external metal-center edge.
definitions.resolved_status: Resolved denotes a source-supported structural record object; it does not by itself imply exact canonical identity or CShM support.
definitions.scope_coverage: Conditional completeness within output-assigned emitted scopes; not an independently stratified source-population coverage rate.
definitions.strict_single_and_multiple_metal_center_: A strict nonpolymeric single-metal-center entry has exactly one in-domain metal center and no direct or shared-donor relation to an external metal. The multiple-center category includes either multiple in-domain metal centers or a direct or shared-donor relation to an external metal. The two nonpolymeric classes and the polymeric class are mutually exclusive.

scope_counts_note: Implementation routing labels only; confirmed haptic sites, ambiguous collective-site candidates, and audit-only sites are reported separately.

statistical_frame.note: Fractions are exact descriptive proportions for the frozen release; no binomial confidence interval or population generalization is implied.
